name: Háromhuta (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Háromhuta: a green shield with yellow charges, with a helm, a stag crest and green and yellow mantling, above a scroll inscribed HÁROMHUTA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Háromhuta arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
